title: Fatteh Stuffed Kidney Beans
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish that combines the exotic flavors of middle eastern cuisine with the comfort of stuffed kidney beans.
instructions: In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cooked kidney beans, crumbled fatteh, and exotic spices to the pan.
Mix well to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional fatteh.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly browned.
